purpose: Tres tramos sencillos e independientes para convertir a 3D, sin fondo ni vehículos.

assets.label: Avenida recta
assets.prompt: Create a premium realistic 3D GAME ASSET REFERENCE IMAGE for image-to-3D reconstruction for PARKUT, a contemporary urban rooftop parkour game. EXACTLY ONE simple isolated LONG WIDE URBAN ROAD SEGMENT, not a city map, not a network of blocks. Match a modern city of lightly aged warm gray concrete and realistic dark asphalt, refined detailed PBR game art. The avenue has FOUR generous lanes, two each direction, a continuous double yellow center line where legally appropriate, clean white lane dividers, pale concrete sidewalks and low curbs on both sides. Road surface and sidewalks must be predominantly FLAT, with only thin realistic pavement thickness at the exposed perimeter, NO thick raised diorama pedestal. Orthographic elevated three-quarter view, about 55 degrees downward, long road diagonally from lower left towards upper right, every end fully visible, entire asset with 10 percent clear margin around its silhouette. Soft neutral daylight with detail on asphalt grain, subtle restrained wear, concrete joints, tactile curb ramps, realistic drainage grates, metal traffic-light poles and ordinary traffic signs with clean simple pictograms. Keep roadway wide, visually clear, uncluttered, easy to reconstruct as one 3D road module. The open road ends have squared straight clean cuts across the road and sidewalks, so identical-width modules can connect seamlessly later. Isolated on a true TRANSPARENT background, including spaces outside all road edges. No terrain, buildings, empty city lots, trees, sky, distant city, cars, motorcycles, bicycles, people, advertising, labels outside the asset, logos, watermark, shadows projected onto a background, no extra disconnected objects. One road module only. Landscape 3:2 composition. MODULE DESIGN: one straight extra-long avenue section, roughly 110 meters long and 18 meters wide including sidewalks. It continues straight at both ends. Just ONE pedestrian crossing across its middle, with a pair of zebra stripes and two realistic traffic signal mast arms aligned perpendicular to traffic, signal heads facing approaching drivers in their correct direction. Traffic lights have conventional red amber green lenses, only red illuminated. Include two restrained speed-limit signs showing exactly '40', one for each travel direction. No side streets, intersections, medians, parking lots or extra structures. The visual emphasis is a long open usable road.
assets.framing_edit: Edit this isolated road reference: preserve exactly the same long straight four-lane avenue, materials, road markings, sidewalks, pedestrian crossing, two traffic lights and speed signs. ONLY change the framing and complete any clipped extremity. Zoom the camera OUT by 25 percent and center the ENTIRE road segment. Both ends of the road and both full sidewalk end edges MUST be entirely visible inside the image, including the upper-right end that is currently clipped. There must be at least 100 pixels of fully transparent empty margin on ALL four image edges. Keep the same elevated orthographic three-quarter viewing direction and realistic game-asset rendering. The segment is a complete finite long road module with two clean square cut ends. Preserve transparent background. No cars, buildings, people, terrain or other extra elements. Do not crop any part of the asset.
